name: Spy Extraordinaire (CR 25)
body:
SPY EXTRAORDINAIRE
CR 25

Human unchained rogue 1 (master of disguise)/sorcerer (crossblooded) 19/reluctant hero-trickster 10
CG Medium humanoid (human)
Init +18, amazing initiative; Senses Perception +8

DEFENSE

AC 34, touch 22, flat-footed 27 (+7 armor, +5 deflection, +6 Dex, +1 dodge, +5 natural)
hp 233 (19d6+1d8+120+40)
Fort +16, Ref +22, Will +20
Defensive Abilities force of will, hard to kill, hide aura, immortal, mythic saves, recuperation, unstoppable

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee +5 concealed shocking burst stage shortsword +24/+19 (1d6+13 +1d6 electricity, 19-20 +1d10 electricity)
Ranged +5 endless ammunition glamered hand crossbow +22 (1d4+5, 19-20)
Special Attacks clown, combat trickery, mythic power 23/day, sneak attack +1d6, supreme trickster, surge +1d12, surprise strike
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 20th; concentration +28)

Constant—nondetection M

Sorcerer Spells Known (CL 19th; concentration +27)

9th Level (4/day)—fiery body, shapechangeb M
8th Level (7/day)—form of the dragon III, frightful aspect B, giant form II M, iron body, undead anatomy IV
7th Level (7/day)—elemental body IV, form of the dragon II, giant form I, greater polymorphb M, magical beast shape M
6th Level (7/day)—beast shape IV M, elemental body III, fey form II, form of the dragon I, transformation B
5th Level (7/day)—beast shape III, elemental body II, object form III, ooze form I, plant shape I, polymorph B M
4th Level (8/day)—aberrant form I, beast shape IIB, elemental body I, fey form I, stoneskin, vermin shape I M
3rd Level (8/day)—ape walk, beast shape I, flyB, infuse self, monstrous physique I M, undead anatomy I
2nd Level (8/day)—alter selfB M, darkvision, dragonvoice, extreme flexibility, hideous laughter (DC 20), lesser proxy aspectlo, raven’s flight
1st Level (8/day)—blend with surroundings, bouncy body, disguise selfB M, enlarge person (DC 19), expeditious retreat, fabricate disguise, reduce person (DC 19)
0-Level (at will)—chameleon scales, detect magic, ghost sound (DC 18), haunted fey aspect, message, read magic, oath of anonymity, open/close, scrivener’s chantsos, sotto vocefg (DC 18), vacuous vesselbm (DC 18)

Bloodlines Shapechanger, Rakshasa

STATISTICS

Str 16, Dex 26, Con 20, Int 22, Wis 19, Cha 27
Base Atk +9, CMB +17, CMD 30
Traits Mentored, Tenacious Shifting
Feats Agile Maneuvers, Arcane Armor Training*, Combat Expertise, Deceitfulm *, Diva Strikeag, Diva Styleag, Dodge, Dual Path M, Eschew Materials*, Extend Spell M *, Fool Magic, Improved Feint, Iron Will, Stage Combatant, Toughness*, Weapon Finesse M *, Weapon Focus M (shortsword)
Skills Bluff +35/+36, Diplomacy +11/+16, Disguise +35, Knowledge (arcana) +10, Knowledge (local) +10, Linguistics +10, Perform (act) +32, Perform (comedy) +31, Perform (oratory) +31, Profession (actor) +28, Perception +8, Sense Motive +27, Spellcraft +10, Stealth +31, Use Magic Device +32
Languages Common, Draconic, Dwarven, Elven, Giant, Infernal, Protean, Sylvan
SQ bloodline arcanas, class mimic, consummate actor, learning by example x2 (enduring blessing x2), legendary hero, mutable flesh 3/day, mythic bloodline (power), mythic spellcasting, non-combatant, perfect mimic, sardonic wit, silver tongue 21/day, superior transformation, use everything
Gear amulet of natural armor +5, belt of physical perfection +6, book of perfect jokesma, bottle of fine wine, cloak of quick reflexes +5/+6, disguise kit, +5 endless ammunition glamered hand crossbow, hat of infinite disguises, headband of mental superiority +6, +5 transforming leather armor, 2 potions of serious wounds, ring of protection +5, +5 concealed shocking burst stage shortsword, sleeves of many garments, sorcerer’s kit, staff of transmutation, tome of epics, unfettered shirt, 212 gp
